title: Jim's pottery epiphany and fixation on ancient sites
summary: Jim Weiner tells of Jim's pottery epiphany and fixation on ancient sites, about days after August 1976 at an unknown place, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: all of a sudden this thing came into my head fully developed

plain: Jim Weiner, a man who tells his story on a podcast episode about alien abduction, says that in the days after August 1976 an idea about pottery suddenly came into his head, fully formed. He says that after this he became fixed on ancient sites. He tells it as one of the strange after-effects of what he went through, as if something had been placed in his mind.
